_comment: Per-server values. Copy to config.json and fill in (see kit/detect.py output). config.json is not committed. Without it the board runs with defaults (lang en · UTC · port 8800). lang = board screen (en | ko). aiLang = language the AI sessions write their reports and questions in — any language, e.g. "日本語", "Español", "Deutsch" (empty = same as lang). docsUrl = where «First install and full guide» points (empty = the docs this board serves at /docs/INSTALL.md). ntfy = phone alerts through the free ntfy app — set it from the board («Alerts»), only one line (project · session · question title) is sent. team = who may use this board (server accounts) and how — set it from the board («⚙ Team & roles»): members [{user, name, role owner|member|viewer, projects, tailscale}], approval (member tasks need the final approver), smallDirect, memberAnswers own|project|none, deployConfirm [project keys needing «Checked» before deploy]. Empty = owner only; other server accounts cannot open the board.
